name: Data Engineering Programming & Systems
description: Proficiency in core programming languages for data engineering (Python, Scala/Java, SQL), object-oriented and functional data processing, type safety, concurrency, memory management, and serialization protocols.

subskills.name: Python Core & Object-Oriented Design
subskills.description: Data structures, generators, decorators, context managers, classes, abstract base classes, and clean architecture in Python.

subskills.name: Type Safety & Specialized Data Structures
subskills.description: Type hinting with typing module, Pydantic data validation, collections (deque, defaultdict, Counter), and efficient in-memory data structures.

subskills.name: Functional Data Processing & Immutability
subskills.description: Pure functions, immutability, map/filter/reduce, lambda expressions, itertools, functools, and functional pipelines.

subskills.name: Concurrency, Multiprocessing & AsyncIO
subskills.description: Thread vs Process vs Coroutine, ThreadPoolExecutor, ProcessPoolExecutor, asyncio for I/O-bound data fetching, and GIL implications.

subskills.name: Memory Management & Performance Profiling
subskills.description: Garbage collection, memory leaks in long-running jobs, memory profiling (memory_profiler, tracemalloc), cProfile, and CPU profiling.

subskills.name: Data Serialization & Binary Protocols
subskills.description: Working with JSON, Pickle, Protocol Buffers (protobuf), FlatBuffers, Avro, MessagePack, and schema evolution rules.

subskills.name: Scala & JVM Ecosystem for Big Data
subskills.description: Scala syntax, case classes, pattern matching, traits, implicits, JVM memory tuning, and sbt build tool for big data engines.

subskills.name: Algorithms & Data Structures for Scale
subskills.description: Sorting, searching, hash maps, binary trees, graph traversals for DAG dependencies, and Big-O computational complexity.

subskills.name: Packaging, Environments & Dependency Isolation
subskills.description: Managing virtual environments (venv, uv, poetry), wheel builds, pyproject.toml, requirements locking, and private PyPI registries.

cv.signal: Designed high-throughput Python data pipelines and microservices
Developed big data processing jobs in Scala using JVM optimization

linkedin.signal: Skill endorsements for Python, Scala, and Concurrency

assessment.signal: Passes Python/Scala algorithms and concurrent data pipeline test

junior.description: Writes clean, type-annotated Python scripts, manages virtual environments, and builds OOP data extraction utilities.

mid.description: Builds high-throughput concurrent data applications, applies functional paradigms, and optimizes data serialization.

senior.description: Solves complex memory leaks, profiles CPU/memory bottlenecks in long-running jobs, and architects Scala/JVM data pipelines.
